characters.CEYX: a bearded greek king (dark curly hair, short dark beard, red cloak)

verse: ne me fugiens ventos sequerere rogabam
Ich bat dich, nicht vor mir fliehend den Winden zu folgen.
hafen_1.image: wide shot of a small ancient greek stone harbour at dawn, an ancient greek galley with one mast, a single square linen sail and a row of oars ready to depart, sailors loading, calm grey sea, soft pink morning mist
hafen_1.motion: slow cinematic dolly forward over the harbour, sail gently moving in the wind, sailors walking, gentle waves

hafen_2.image: medium shot on a stone quay at dawn: a young woman with long dark hair in a plain white dress holds the hands of a bearded man wearing a dark red cloak, she looks at him pleading, an ancient greek galley behind them, morning mist
hafen_2.motion: she grips his hands tighter and speaks pleadingly, his cloak moving in the wind, slow push in

hafen_rede.image: close-up portrait facing the camera of a young greek woman with long dark wavy hair in a plain white linen dress, speaking softly and pleading, worried eyes, a bearded man in a dark red cloak blurred in the foreground at the edge of the frame, misty harbour at dawn behind her
hafen_rede.motion: she looks at him silently with pleading eyes, lips closed, slight head movement, hair moves in the breeze, static camera, face stays stable
hafen_rede.subtitle: Sie bittet ihn, sie mitzunehmen oder zu bleiben – sie fürchtet die Winde.

options.label: Sie fleht ihn an zu bleiben
Sie lässt ihn mit einem Kuss ziehen

hafen_flehen.image: close-up portrait of a young greek woman with long dark wavy hair in a plain white dress, tears in her eyes, pleading, her hand clutching a dark red cloth, harbour in soft focus behind, cold morning light
hafen_flehen.motion: she clutches the red cloak and shakes her head slowly, tears running, subtle handheld camera

hafen_schwur.image: close-up portrait facing the camera of a bearded greek king in his thirties with dark curly hair and a dark red wool cloak, speaking earnestly and gently, determined eyes, misty harbour at dawn behind him
hafen_schwur.motion: he looks at her silently with a calm determined expression, lips closed, slight nod, cloak moves in the wind, static camera, face stays stable
hafen_schwur.subtitle: Er schwört beim Feuer seines Vaters: Bevor der Mond zweimal voll ist, kehrt er zurück.

hafen_kuss.image: close-up of a farewell kiss on a quay: a bearded man in a dark red cloak kisses the forehead of a young woman with long dark hair in a plain white dress, warm first sunlight through mist
hafen_kuss.motion: a gentle farewell kiss, foreheads touching, sunlight flickering through mist, slow orbit around them
hafen_kuss.subtitle: hoc mihi discedens dedit oscula litore – An diesem Ufer küsste er sie zum Abschied.

hafen_abfahrt.image: wide shot from behind ALCYONE standing alone at the end of a stone quay, watching an ancient greek galley with one square sail and oars leave the harbour into the misty sea
hafen_abfahrt.motion: the ship sails slowly away into the mist, her dress and hair move in the wind, static camera
hafen_abfahrt.subtitle: hic retinacula solvit – Hier löste er die Taue.

verse: Die Flut türmt sich und scheint den Himmel zu erreichen.

sturm_2.motion: the breaking wave collapses over the deck, the hull rolls onto its side and is pulled under the water, the mast goes down with it, only churning foam and broken planks are left on the heaving sea, rain keeps falling, handheld camera, realistic heavy water physics, no cut

sturm_3.motion: he clings to the plank as waves lift and drop him, rain pouring, lightning flashes on his face

sturm_ruf.subtitle: nominat Alcyonen ipsisque inmurmurat undis – Er nennt Alkyones Namen und murmelt ihn in die Wellen.

sturm_stern.motion: black storm clouds slowly swallow the bright star, lightning inside the clouds
sturm_stern.subtitle: Lucifer obscurus – Der Morgenstern, sein Vater, verhüllt sein Gesicht.

sturm_welle.image: close shot of a drowning bearded man in a soaked red cloak in the black storm sea at night, head and shoulders above the choppy water, arms gripping a broken wooden plank, rain, lightning
sturm_welle.motion: he struggles in the water, arms pulling at the plank, head lifting to breathe, waves lift and drop him, then a dark wall of water rises behind him and collapses over him, he disappears under the churning white foam, handheld camera, realistic heavy water physics
sturm_welle.subtitle: Ein schwarzer Bogen aus Wasser bricht über ihm zusammen.
sturm_welle.end_image: a wall of black storm water and churning white foam filling the frame at night, no person

warten_1.image: ALCYONE sitting at a window of a bronze age palace room at dusk looking out at a calm grey sea, oil lamps, warm and cold light mixing
warten_1.motion: she gazes at the sea, lamp flames flicker, curtains move slightly, slow push in

options.label: Sie betet im Tempel der Juno

warten_gebet.motion: incense smoke curls up through the light beam, she lifts her hands in prayer
warten_gebet.subtitle: Sie betet für einen, der nicht mehr lebt.

warten_weben.motion: her hands pass the shuttle through the threads, lamp light flickers
warten_weben.subtitle: Sie webt Kleider, die er tragen soll, wenn er heimkehrt.

verse: Erkennst du Ceyx, du ärmste Gemahlin?

traum_1.motion: the pale translucent bearded ghost slowly leans over the sleeping woman, water drips from his hair and beard, blue mist drifts through the room, she stirs slightly in her sleep, static camera
traum_1.subtitle: Im Traum steht Ceyx vor ihr, bleich und triefend: Er sei tot, der Südwind habe sein Schiff zerschlagen.

traum_1.negative: veil, hood, shroud, female ghost, sheet ghost, faceless

traum_greifen.motion: she weeps in her sleep, then slowly lifts both arms upward as if to embrace someone leaning over her, her arms close around empty air and she hugs nothing, her arms sink back onto her chest, her lips tremble, slow natural motion, static camera

traum_greifen.goal: Ovid Met. XI 674-676: Alcyone stöhnt und weint im Schlaf, bewegt die Arme, sucht seinen Körper und umarmt nur Luft. Nahaufnahme nur von ihr; Ceyx ist in traum_1 schon am Bett zu sehen. Sie liegt, sie setzt sich nicht auf, langsame schlafwandlerische Bewegung.

traum_fragen.image: close-up of the pale translucent face of a bearded man glowing faintly blue in a dark room, wet dark curly hair, sad eyes, a single tear, no hood, bare shoulders, blue moonlight
traum_fragen.motion: a single tear slowly runs down his pale face, he looks at the camera, blue mist drifts slowly, almost still
traum_fragen.subtitle: Kein Bote sei er – er selbst verkünde ihr sein Schicksal. Sie solle um ihn weinen.

traum_erwachen.image: a young woman with long dark curly hair in a long-sleeved high-necked white linen nightgown sitting alone on a bed crying in grief, ancient stone bedroom lit by small clay oil lamps
traum_erwachen.motion: she weeps and slowly covers her face with both hands, the small oil lamp flames flicker, warm light moves on the stone wall, still camera, no other people
traum_erwachen.subtitle: nulla est Alcyone, nulla est – Nun ist es aus mit ihr, klagt Alkyone.
